correctness.rationale: Geometric smoothness of a ternary characteristic-two cubic is equivalent via Euler identity and Jacobian partial quadrics to absence of a nonzero common projective root. Independently tested 1023 nonzero cubic masks: 336 smooth; exhaustive addition of smooth cosets generates 5544 pencils and 864 smooth nets, and all 168 GL3(F2) coordinate transforms split these into five orbits size168 and three size8. Reconstructed all five point-count spectra of the eight representative nets. This is an exhaustive finite classification with algebraic-closure correctness, not mere F2^r point scans.
